parsed.name: QuTech中央控制器
parsed.description: 用于量子计算实验的中央控制电子设备，通常基于FPGA执行时序与序列程序，协调CCIO模块、数字I/O链路和时序延迟设置，为量子比特控制与读出实验提供同步控制。
parsed.description_en: A central control electronics unit for quantum computing experiments, typically FPGA-based, used to execute timing and sequence programs, coordinate CCIO modules, digital I/O links, and timing delay settings, and provide synchronized control for qubit control and readout experiments.
